source_text.supervisor: USER-PRIORITY: backend tests run 30+ minutes, must be 10. Fix the 8-minute post-test gap in the backend CI gate (run 37641894774: partitions done 15:27:29, 'mix letflow.check.test: OK' 15:35:36). No queue task, no GH issue; commit locally only, no push/PR/merge.

task.description: Root-cause verification of the watchdog orphan in scripts/test_parallel.sh.

result.summary: Confirmed in code: each partition gets a background watchdog subshell (sleep $partition_timeout_s, then TERM/KILL the partition group). Step 3 and the EXIT trap only did kill <subshell pid>, which leaves the subshell's sleep child alive; it inherits the script's stdout/stderr, so any reader of that pipe waits until the sleep exits. Reproduced on Windows git-bash: bash -c 'set -m; (sleep 6; ...) & kill $w; ...' | cat returns after 6168 ms with kill-subshell-only and 367 ms with kill -- -pid. Under the old script the new tests fail 3 of 4 (pipe not released within 40 s); under the fix all 4 pass in ~1-4 s each. Other background jobs: partition mix test jobs and the create/migrate subshells redirect to log files (do not hold the pipe) and are reaped by group in the trap; the opt-in connection sampler subshell is killed by pid only and could leave a 'sleep 1' alive for at most 1 s (bounded, opt-in, left unchanged).
